robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Grant Ave delivery. I will keep the doorway clear.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: The order is ready for collection. I am waiting in the marked place.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Stockton St crossing detected. Waiting for the walk signal.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: This bag is full. The next stop will make it lighter.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: I will take the ramp and meet the recipient at the agreed entrance.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: The pavement is busy. Reducing speed rather than requesting space.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Broadway is the next turn. The route stays on the crossing.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: One delivery, then I leave. A simple and complete plan.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: The shop has not opened yet. I can wait without blocking the shutters.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: A small parcel for the next block. Carried with ordinary care.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: The doorway is occupied. I will stop where people can pass.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Battery sufficient for the route and the return.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Checking the pickup code after stopping.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: The bag has changed hands. Confirmation received.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: No delivery here. Continuing to the correct entrance.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Following the queue at the same pace as everyone else.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: The signal is still waiting. So am I.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: I can use the longer route without making it anyone else’s problem.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: The package is secure for the hill.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Delivery complete. Thank you for the directions.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: We approach the door, then turn away. A renewable opportunity.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: The same three paces again. The route has become a business model.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Our bag contains a proposition rather than a parcel.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: We are counting doorways for a market-size slide.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: This block has appeared in our active-route metric seven times.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: The delivery is scheduled for after the announcement.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: I am waiting for a customer who has not placed an order.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: The route ends just before the part where someone checks the bag.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Please rate the pavement. The questionnaire is the service.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Our next lap will validate the previous lap.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: The door is open, but completion would reduce our session length.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: We have confused foot traffic with customer interest.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: An empty bag makes our unit economics look lighter.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: The pickup code is on the slide after the revenue projection.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: I circle the corner because the chart rewards motion.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: The package is in a future release.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: The queue moved; our pitch did not.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: We are collecting impressions at this entrance without entering.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: I recognise this corner. We are calling that a data advantage.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: The actual delivery has been deferred pending a narrative update.

peopleLines.speaker: person
peopleLines.text: I am meeting someone on Grant Ave. The correct corner would help.

peopleLines.speaker: person
peopleLines.text: Stockton St is busy. I will put the phone away for the crossing.

peopleLines.speaker: person
peopleLines.text: The shop opens in a minute. There is room to wait over here.

peopleLines.speaker: person
peopleLines.text: The parcel arrived before the tracking page caught up.

peopleLines.speaker: person
peopleLines.text: Broadway is the next turn, then we can check the map again.

peopleLines.speaker: person
peopleLines.text: I have the pickup code. It is the only password I need today.

peopleLines.speaker: person
peopleLines.text: The doorway needs to stay clear. We can finish talking beside it.

peopleLines.speaker: person
peopleLines.text: I like walking this block before the afternoon gets busy.

peopleLines.speaker: person
peopleLines.text: The robot waited for everyone to pass before turning.

peopleLines.speaker: person
peopleLines.text: The hill looks smaller until you carry the bags up it.

peopleLines.speaker: person
peopleLines.text: I am choosing the ramp. We will arrive at the same entrance.

peopleLines.speaker: person
peopleLines.text: That delivery has a real address and someone expecting it.

peopleLines.speaker: person
peopleLines.text: The light changed. We have plenty of time to cross normally.

peopleLines.speaker: person
peopleLines.text: I came out for one errand and found a useful walking route.

peopleLines.speaker: person
peopleLines.text: The window tells me the opening hours without an app.

peopleLines.speaker: person
peopleLines.text: We are on the right street. The map can stop spinning now.

peopleLines.speaker: person
peopleLines.text: The bag is heavier on the way home. This is a successful shopping trip.

peopleLines.speaker: person
peopleLines.text: I will answer the message after we have crossed Stockton.

peopleLines.speaker: person
peopleLines.text: There is a quiet patch beside the wall if we need to check the address.

peopleLines.speaker: person
peopleLines.text: The fog has reached the roofline but not this patch of sun.

peopleLines.speaker: person
peopleLines.text: I can hear the tunnel traffic from this corner.

peopleLines.speaker: person
peopleLines.text: We have time to take the route with fewer steps.

peopleLines.speaker: person
peopleLines.text: The counter has the order. I appreciate a complete handoff.

peopleLines.speaker: person
peopleLines.text: I am leaving space for the person coming through the door.

peopleLines.speaker: person
peopleLines.text: The pickup notice arrived at the same time as the parcel.

peopleLines.speaker: person
peopleLines.text: We can wait here without adding ourselves to the queue.

peopleLines.speaker: person
peopleLines.text: The route is familiar. I still watch the crossings.

peopleLines.speaker: person
peopleLines.text: I wrote the address down before the phone decided to update.

peopleLines.speaker: person
peopleLines.text: That robot is doing an errand. We can let it get on with it.

peopleLines.speaker: person
peopleLines.text: The next block is uphill, so I am adjusting the pace now.

peopleLines.speaker: person
peopleLines.text: I found what I needed. No recommendation feed required.

peopleLines.speaker: person
peopleLines.text: One message can wait until the bags are down.

peopleLines.speaker: person
peopleLines.text: The sun moved while we were inside. Good reason to walk the other side.

peopleLines.speaker: person
peopleLines.text: The crossing is clear after this group, not before it.

peopleLines.speaker: person
peopleLines.text: The door opens toward us. Let us move back a little.

peopleLines.speaker: person
peopleLines.text: I have finished the errand without turning it into a whole project.

peopleLines.speaker: person
peopleLines.text: The pavement is busy enough. My suitcase can roll behind me.

peopleLines.speaker: person
peopleLines.text: We are meeting at the entrance, not in the entrance.

peopleLines.speaker: person
peopleLines.text: That was a useful walk. I will take this route again.

peopleLines.speaker: person
peopleLines.text: I can check the next turn from the corner without stopping everyone.

bounties.posting: A courier repeats the same short approach without delivering. Observe the route before responding.
bounties.tellHint: Watch the repeated three-step loop and check whether the bag ever changes hands.

provenance.review: Root independently read all lines with no taste, identity or punching-down issue. Geographic data is separately validated against canonical pipeline polygons.
